name: vivi
description: Open local artifacts for human review and apply published Vivi feedback on demand.

interface.shortDescription: Open artifacts and apply review feedback.
interface.longDescription: Open local artifacts in the appropriate Vivi workspace, retrieve published feedback on demand, apply and verify changes, and return document links for human re-review.
defaultPrompt: Use $open to open my document in Vivi for review.
Use $apply-feedback to apply my published Vivi feedback.
